notes: Removed the Camera feature from the active Cyberdeck runtime
Removed the JACK IN CAMERA button and all camera placement actions
Deleted FEHA_CAMERA_PLACEMENT.js and removed it from the dev loader
Removed Camera from the Network Device type registry
Legacy camera Scene records are ignored by Network Device scanning so old development data does not reappear in JACK IN
Removed camera-specific Cyberdeck CSS and restored the JACK IN viewport controls to the non-camera layout
Device runtime now consists of Cyber Core, Network Devices, Device Actions, Network Approvals, and V3 UI
JACK IN viewport no longer allows zoom below 100%, preventing whole-UI raster downscaling
FIT now recenters the topology at native 100% resolution instead of shrinking the world to 65–80%
Native-scale pan is rounded to whole pixels to reduce subpixel blur in text and portraits
Actor-backed endpoint cards now prefer the full Actor/character portrait over lower-resolution Token textures
Removed the JACK IN world will-change transform hint so Chromium does not unnecessarily pre-rasterize the entire topology layer
knownLimitations: Camera functionality does not exist in 0.10.2 and should be treated as a future feature rather than a partial implementation
Turret ROTATE/FIRE still require a future turret adapter
Status effects and non-damage Quickhack secondary effects are still not yet Active Effects
Quickhack rules still use effectText parsing as a legacy bridge pending explicit schema migration
The dev loader remains GM-only; player-client multiplayer device testing requires the modular runtime to be loaded through the actual FEHA module or an equivalent player-safe dev bootstrap
